name: 4-MMC
one_liner: The one. Everything after this is a cover band.
positives_writeup: Rush: snorted, the hit old UK threads treated like scripture — coke-shaped, immediate, Erowid's 'pleasurable rushing.' Oral is slower and still a lift. Euphoria: the legend. Empathy, music, talk, MDMA-plus-speed without the visuals. Pre-ban batches are the ghost every analog chases. Compulsiveness: extreme and independent of how much they loved it — bags evaporate chasing the first rush. Enjoyment: highest in the family when the stamp is real.
negatives_writeup: Jaw, sweat, palpitations, insomnia, memory holes. Comedown scales with how hard they chased. Insufflation wrecks the nose. Not dope-sick. Psychologically greedy.

name: 3-MMC
one_liner: Diet 4-MMC. Fine until the bag is NEP.
positives_writeup: Rush: real. Some crystal batches fooled old 4-MMC heads; most later bags are more speed, less velvet. Euphoria: the stand-in that actually worked — less hug, more grind and talk. Chemsex favorite. Compulsiveness: high even when they call it meh. Finished the bag anyway. Enjoyment: best of the copies when genuine.
negatives_writeup: Batch lottery. Tachycardia. Chemsex harm cluster. After 2022 control the name stayed on bags that were 2-MMC or colder long stims. If it lasts till noon it was not 3-MMC.

name: Methcathinone
one_liner: The Soviet bathroom legend. Parent stamp, not the meow hug.
positives_writeup: Rush: old jeff stories — dirty, strong, catecholamine-heavy. Euphoria: speed, not roll. The thing 4-MMC dressed up. Compulsiveness: classic stimulant greedy, different culture than 2009 meow. Enjoyment: historical, not the party SKU.
negatives_writeup: UN Schedule I parent. Manganese-tremor folklore belongs to a method we are not writing. Ambiguous street word MCAT also means mephedrone.
